title: Trend-day NIFTY option buying on an opening-range break
hypothesis: On sessions with India VIX below a cap, buying the NIFTY weekly ATM option in the direction of an opening-range break and selling by 15:15 earns a positive expectancy after charges.

mechanism.text: On a true trend day realised volatility exceeds what the morning premium priced.

evidence.finding: 91.5% of individual option traders lost money.

evidence.source: SEBI study of FY25-FY26 (as summarised on tradingqna.com)
evidence.finding: About 90% of option-buyer-only traders lost money.

universe.name: nifty-weekly-options
universe.rule: The nearest weekly expiry, ATM strike at the signal.

turnover.basis: costs about 4-6% of the premium a round trip, modelled per trade

needs: intraday option prices (model-priced in train and validation)
live captured option chains for the holdout
available_now: Upstox v3 index minute candles from Jan 2022 (with a token)

prior_trials.basis: orb15-vwap's grid: the same opening-range idea on stocks.

gates.span_exception: No historical intraday option prices: train and validation are Black-76 model prices from index minute bars and India VIX; the holdout is the live captured chain from 16 Nov 2026. About 5.4 years in all.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout expectancy after charges above zero over at least 30 trades on real captured option prices.

kill_criteria: Holdout expectancy at or below zero after charges.
Validation (model-priced) expectancy at or below zero: the holdout is then not opened.

prior.reason: Option buying pays the volatility risk premium; SEBI finds about 90% of buyers lose.

feasibility.reason: No historical intraday option data; model prices are weak evidence; needs #73 and #76.

contamination: The holdout is future data, unseen by construction.
